content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER - runtime-prefill cluster eu-west-2a: multiple container restarts (7) in 2m, symptom: CUDA OOM during prefill for large-context requests. Auto-shed triggered. Severity: P1
maya_oncall: ack I’m on it. moving to bridge now.
sam_ops: seeing repeated OOM traces w/ long prompt sizes (~>65k tokens) from a single client IP range. spike started ~T-4m.
kevin_ml: log snippet suggests CUDA alloc failure inside attention kernel at mem.cu:243
```
E cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
stack: runtime_prefill::prefill_step -> attention_kernel -> cudaMalloc
GPU0 free: 120MB, requested: 512MB
```
sam_ops: repro locally w/ long context test -> container restarts after 2 prefills. probable KV cache blowup.
daria_sre: taking node action: cordoning node gpu-12, draining hotpool instances. will move traffic off affected AZ.
maya_oncall: applied route override -> redirect 35% of prefills to model-quantized-v2 (smaller mem) and enabled prefix-trim policy for 60s. watching metrics.
incident-bot: deploy-bot reports rollout success for route override at +90s. error-rate dropped from 4.2% -> 1.3% in monitored routes.
kevin_ml: quick mitigations: 1) enable aggressive kvcache eviction (ttl 30s) 2) block requests > 48k tokens at router 3) route top offending API key to dedicated fallback model.
sam_ops: executed eviction change and router block. here's the command used:
```bash
rictl routing update --rule "prefill_max_tokens <= 48000" --action reject --reason "mitigate OOM spike"
rictl runtime set kvcache.eviction_ttl=30s --scope eu-west-2a
```
alex_support: starting customer outreach. initial check: 3 customers reported elevated 5xx rates; one customer (org: finlytics) had 30 failed requests. drafting message.
maya_oncall: confirming no data loss. metrics indicate prefills retried and served successfully via fallback for ~70% of requests. SLO impact limited to increased latency and some failed requests for those routed to reject.
daria_sre: node gpu-12 shows repeated cuda kernel timeouts; we drained and restarted container runtime. will open a host-level ticket.
kevin_ml: please save a sample request (anonymized) that triggers the long prefill sequence. suspect prompt-engineered attack or inadvertent user bug.
amaz: (bot) alert: cost spike alert fired for model-quantized-v2 due to burst routing.
maya_oncall: noted. cost team FYI but we kept it temporary.
alex_support: customer notif sent to finlytics and two other impacted orgs — stating we mitigated and will follow up with root cause.
oncall_next: I’ll take 03:00 UTC handoff. next steps: collect GPU traces, full device dmesg, and iterate on automatic long-prompt throttling.
maya_oncall: added followups -> JIRA INF-1234 (prefill OOM prevention), tag: long-context, priority: high.
incident-bot: incident record created: INC-2026-042-2999004321. postmortem owner assigned: kevin_ml.
maya_oncall: wrapping up on-call bridge in 15m. leaving detailed notes in the incident doc and pinging infra for host remediation. thanks all. :thumbsup:
oncall_next: ack, taking over monitoring. will escalate if restarts resume.
